nodes.summary: For natural numbers $i$ and $n$, this is the list of $n$ booleans $(b_0, \dots, b_{n-1})$, least significant bit first, where $b_k$ is true exactly when $\lfloor i / 2^k \rfloor$ is odd. For $i < 2^n$ it is the $n$-bit binary expansion of $i$; in general it is the $n$-bit expansion of $i \bmod 2^n$.
nodes.title: Fixed-length binary expansion (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: A list of booleans $(b_0, \dots, b_{m-1})$, read least significant bit first, denotes the natural number $\sum_{k < m} [b_k] \, 2^k$, where $[b_k]$ is $1$ if $b_k$ is true and $0$ otherwise; the empty list denotes $0$.
nodes.title: Number with a given binary expansion (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, $a$ a list of booleans and $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Decode each gate of $C$ into a gate of a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, and assign to input $j < n$ the entry $a_j$ of $a$, read as false when $j$ is at least the length of $a$. The result is the list of the values of all gates of the decoded circuit under this assignment, in order.
nodes.title: Gate values of an encoded circuit (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, $a$ a list of booleans and $k, n \in \mathbb{N}$. Decode each gate of $C$ into a gate of a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs and evaluate the decoded circuit with input $j < n$ set to the entry $a_j$ of $a$, read as false when $j$ is at least the length of $a$. The outputs of $C$ on $a$ are the last $k$ of the resulting gate values, or all of them if $C$ has fewer than $k$ gates.
nodes.title: Outputs of an encoded circuit (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: An encoded gate is a pair $(k, r)$ of a natural number $k$, the kind of the gate, and a list $r$ of natural numbers, its references.
nodes.title: Encoded gates (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: A list $C$ of encoded gates is a well-formed description circuit on $n$ inputs when $C$ has at least $2n + 3$ gates and the flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs obtained by decoding each gate of $C$ is well-formed, that is, every gate references only strictly earlier gates.
nodes.title: Well-formed description circuits (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates and let $n, i \in \mathbb{N}$. Decode each gate of $C$ into a gate of a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs and evaluate it with input $j < n$ set to bit $j$ of $i$, least significant bit first, that is, true exactly when $\lfloor i / 2^j \rfloor$ is odd. The description of gate $i$ of the circuit succinctly described by $C$ is the list of the last $2n + 3$ resulting gate values,…
nodes.title: Gate description in a succinct circuit (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and $x$ a list of booleans. The gate values of the circuit with $2^n$ gates succinctly described by $C$ on input $x$ form the list $(v_0, \dots, v_{2^n - 1})$, where each $v_i$ is the value of gate $i$ given $x$ and the values $(v_0, \dots, v_{i-1})$ of the earlier gates.
nodes.title: Evaluation of a succinct circuit (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, let $n, i \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $d$ be the description of gate $i$ of the circuit succinctly described by $C$: decode each gate of $C$ into a gate of a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, evaluate the decoded circuit with input $j < n$ set to bit $j$ of $i$ (true exactly when $\lfloor i / 2^j \rfloor$ is odd), and take the last $2n + 3$ gate values, or all of them if $C$ has…
nodes.title: Decoded gate description (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, let $n, i \in \mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a list of booleans (the input) and let $v$ be a list of booleans (the values of earlier gates), where an entry outside $x$ or $v$ reads as false. Let $(t, p_1, p_2)$ be the decoded description of gate $i$ of the circuit succinctly described by $C$. If $i < n$, gate $i$ is an input gate and its value is $x_i$. Otherwise its value is…
nodes.title: Value of a gate of a succinct circuit (Succinct Circuit Value)

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a list of encoded gates, read as a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs that describes a circuit $D$ with $2^n$ gates. For each gate $i$ of $D$, let $t_i$, $p_i$ and $q_i$ be its gate type, first predecessor and second predecessor, as decoded from the outputs of $C$ on the $n$-bit binary expansion of $i$. nodes.title: Well-formed succinct circuit descriptions

nodes.summary: The decision problem Succinct Circuit Value accepts a bitstring exactly when it decodes to a triple $(n, C, x)$ of a natural number $n$, a list $C$ of encoded gates and a bitstring $x$ such that: $x$ has length $n$; $C$ has at least $2n + 3$ gates and, read as a flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, is well formed; the circuit $D$ with $2^n$ gates succinctly described by $C$, whose gate $i$ is described by the…
nodes.title: Succinct Circuit Value

nodes.summary: The decision problem Succinct Circuit Value belongs to the class EXP, and every decision problem in EXP reduces to Succinct Circuit Value by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: Succinct Circuit Value is EXP-complete

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
